breakage_notes: All five concurrent cloud create requests returned HTTP 429 before any guest was allocated. The free trial enforces a single retained sandbox and a strict create rate limit; the first batch attempt was the only one to receive a guest (sbx-testpolicy018a33b4a1a8). No name collisions were observed because each request uses a unique sbx-[random] name. Cost blow-up is not a risk at this scale but the rate limit is the binding constraint. Evidence is in reports/evidence/cloud_rate_limit.log.
